entities.summary: The Karazhartas Necropolis is one of the megalithic monuments of the Begazy-Dandybai culture of the Late Bronze Age. It is located on the right bank of the Taldy River, 2 km west of the village of Zhanazhurt, 12 km east of the village of Taldy, in the territory of the Taldy Rural District of the Shet District of the Karaganda Region in Kazakhstan.
